0.8.25-dev.3: Optional product HTML hosted separately from the owner panel with client UI APIs.
Shared UI style and product template with dynamic data, loading timeout and focus handover.
0.7.24-dev.3: Locale dictionaries organized into menu, console and notifications groups; nested translation keys supported.
0.6.23-dev.3: Product registration is automatic from the bundled identity and manifest.
Lab translations use a separate locale file; technical probes are isolated from the starter template.
0.5.22-dev.3: Merged startup validation and RZ initialization into shared/utils.lua; only author API files remain at the runtime root.
0.5.21-dev.3: Focused author API files on product scripting; moved platform and panel bindings into internal modules.
0.5.20-dev.3: Separated shared, client and server API entry points into their matching manifest sections.
0.5.18-dev.3: Reorganized SDK into documented client/server API entry points and separate internal modules; existing API contracts preserved.
0.5.17-dev.3: Client configuration uses staggered revision checks and queued replies instead of full broadcasts.
Only changed client-safe fields are transferred; latent delivery, retry and stale-response protection.
0.5.16-dev.3: Notifications rendered by SDK-owned RedM natives without VORP exports or events.
Server Left notification routed to the resource client; texture timeout and persistent handle cleanup.
0.5.14-dev.3: Client API entry renamed to api_client.lua; automatic manifest migration.
17 client notification methods with per-method custom bridges and documented payloads.
0.1.1-dev.3: Build diretta delle cartelle: versione utils automatica, nessuno ZIP.
Versione del manifest unica fonte per il prodotto.
Supporto aggiornamento obbligatorio: gameplay bloccato e menu informativo disponibile.
Verifica SDK STABLE: firma Lua incorporata e registro separato.
0.1.0-dev.3: DEV Lab: configurable menu, persistent preferences, items, rewards and positions.
Signed update registry with offline verification and cumulative release notes.

Replaced full dataset callbacks with incremental version-diff updates
Implemented TriggerLatentClientEvent to prevent large event warnings
Reduced network load and improved multi-player sync reliability
